preset = name:flow, blur_strength:1.10, blur_iterations:2, refraction_strength:0.42, chromatic_aberration:0.18, fresnel_strength:0.46, specular_strength:0.52, glass_opacity:0.88, edge_thickness:0.045, lens_distortion:0.30
preset = name:flow:dark, brightness:0.88, contrast:0.96, saturation:0.92, vibrancy:0.18, adaptive_dim:0.20
windowrule = match:class ^(Pokemon Native Contract Preflight|Agent Orchestrator|Agent-orchestrator|agent-orchestra.*)$, workspace 9 silent
windowrule = match:class ^(Pokemon Native Contract Preflight|Agent Orchestrator|Agent-orchestrator|agent-orchestra.*)$, no_initial_focus on
windowrule = match:class ^(Pokemon Native Contract Preflight|Agent Orchestrator|Agent-orchestrator|agent-orchestra.*)$, no_focus on
bind = $mod, space, exec, qs -c noctalia-shell ipc --any-display call launcher toggle
bind = $mod SHIFT, space, exec, rofi -show run
bind = $mod, V, exec, cliphist list | rofi -dmenu | cliphist decode | wl-copy
bind = $mod SHIFT CTRL, H, movecurrentworkspacetomonitor, l
bind = $mod SHIFT CTRL, L, movecurrentworkspacetomonitor, r
bind = $mod SHIFT CTRL, K, movecurrentworkspacetomonitor, u
bind = $mod SHIFT CTRL, J, movecurrentworkspacetomonitor, d
bind = $mod SHIFT, B, submap, wallpaper · a auto │ s span │ f fill │ i fit │ c center │ t tile │ x stretch
submap = wallpaper · a auto │ s span │ f fill │ i fit │ c center │ t tile │ x stretch
bind = $mod SHIFT, P, exec, grim -g "$(slurp)" - | wl-copy
bind = $mod CTRL SHIFT, P, exec, grim - | wl-copy
bindl = , XF86AudioMute, exec, wpctl set-mute @DEFAULT_AUDIO_SINK@ toggle

bind = $mod SHIFT, A, exec, notify-send -u critical -t 5000 "Audio restart in 3 seconds" "PipeWire will briefly interrupt active streams" && sleep 3 && systemctl --user restart pipewire pipewire-pulse && notify-send "PipeWire" "Audio stack restarted"
bind = $mod SHIFT, X, submap, system · l lock │ n night │ s suspend │ S shutdown │ r reboot │ e exit
submap = system · l lock │ n night │ s suspend │ S shutdown │ r reboot │ e exit
bind = SHIFT, S, exec, systemctl poweroff
exec-once = env GDK_BACKEND=x11 QT_QPA_PLATFORM=xcb WAYLAND_DISPLAY= rustdesk

comments.text: Built against this Hyprland release; loading before sourced colors lets the
pywal generator update the glass tint without transient config errors.
Verify connector names with: hyprctl monitors
X11 -> Wayland mapping: HDMI-0 -> HDMI-A-1, DP-2 -> DP-2, DP-0 -> DP-1
Center portrait - AOP 25XV2Q F (was DP-2, rotated left)
Right primary - ASUS ROG PG248QP (was DP-0)
On-demand S25 Ultra canvas; created by scripts/phone-display.sh.
Workspace-monitor assignments removed — workspaces show on whichever monitor they're opened on
Preserve the global flat profile for the wired mouse, but let libinput apply
its touchpad-specific adaptive curve to the Bluetooth Apple trackpad.
Sunshine creates these uinput devices when Moonlight sends native pen/touch
packets. Pin their absolute coordinates to the streamed PHONE output so the
S Pen never drives the desktop cursor on a physical monitor.
Native groups: airy tabs with palette colors supplied by pywal below.
Generated active/inactive borders and group tabs. The active gradient rotates
through the current wallpaper palette via the borderangle animation.
Generated by sync-pywal-theme.py; do not edit.
Critical for glass: sample wallpaper at full strength under translucent
windows (Hermes/kitty/Alacritty). Without this, opacity just washes the
UI gray instead of frosting the desktop.
Two-pass preset with visible edge refraction, still bounded for the 540 Hz
display. Fullscreen and media workloads are excluded below.
Disabled: the plugin's framebuffer transform path corrupts rotated outputs.
OBS is a background broadcast surface. It belongs on workspace 8 and must
never pull Kevin away from the active workspace when launched or recovered.
Nested Sway agent-seat (Hyprland window, not VT flip). Super stays on Hyprland.
Workspace 9 = visible isolation. Never 1/2/8. silent = no focus steal.
Emergency containment for the exact app name assigned by Hermes Desktop's
Playwright fixtures. Normal Hermes, browsers, terminals, and editors do not
match. The nested-compositor harness is authoritative; these rules are the
fail-closed host-compositor fallback if a test is launched without it.
Agent-owned native/UI probes must never open on Kevin's active workspace.
Workspace 9 is the visible isolation desktop (Super+9); silent preserves focus.
Agent-built Zen CDA candidates use an explicit class and remain isolated.
Normal signed-in Zen windows do not match this rule.
Preserve low-latency presentation paths for fullscreen and media workloads.
Agent fleet controllers open as centered transient tools, not tiled workspaces.
Chrome PIP (right-click video → Picture in Picture)
Google Meet PIP (title is "Meet - xxx-xxxx-xxx" without " - Google Chrome" suffix)
Kitty uses app-side background_opacity 0.65. Electron/Hermes has no Linux
opacity API — compositor alpha + blur:ignore_opacity = real frost glass.
Hermes must stay compositor-opaque. Applying window opacity samples every
window below Hermes, which can disclose application content through glass.
The plugin renders verified wallpaper pixels inside the opaque window.
Frost the translucent Noctalia surface instead of tinting the whole monitor.
Night mode wake (locked bind — works even with DPMS off)
Noctalia owns the primary application launcher.
HY3 BINDINGS (i3-style tiling) — commented out, hy3 incompatible
Runtime spacing: Super+Ctrl +/- adjusts; Super+Ctrl+0 restores 18/8.
Desktop-shell-aware wallpaper picker and deterministic history navigation
Aural Evolution: 1..9 and 0 select the ten live variants.
Restart PipeWire + WirePlumber (WirePlumber auto-restarts via BindsTo=)
Kokoro TTS: speak selected text aloud (press again to stop)
